name: ktkit
description: Documentation review for Claude Code. docs-review audits a document set with a team of agents that run concurrently and challenge each other's findings. It runs in three shapes: critique one file against the repository and itself, check documents against a standard, or investigate a question across a document set. Separate roles derive requirements, verify every citation, attack Missing verdicts, attack the audit itself, adjudicate findings and gate edits — plus a five-tier ladder that resolves unknowns from the repository before asking you, and a lint that recomputes convergence instead of trusting the report.
